# HORIZON OOH — Egypt's Leading Out-of-Home Advertising Company

> HORIZON OOH is Egypt's premier outdoor advertising agency, specializing in billboard advertising, DOOH (Digital Out-of-Home), mall advertising, airport advertising, and full-cycle OOH media planning and execution across Egypt and the MENA region.

HORIZON OOH provides end-to-end outdoor advertising solutions — from media planning and billboard booking to design production, campaign execution, and performance reporting. With hundreds of premium billboard locations across Egypt's major cities, we help brands maximize their visibility and reach.

## Services

- [Billboard Advertising in Egypt](https://horizonooh.com/services/billboard-advertising-in-egypt): Premium static and lit billboard placements across Egypt's highways, urban centers, and key corridors.
- [DOOH Advertising in Egypt](https://horizonooh.com/services/dooh-advertising-in-egypt): Digital Out-of-Home screens with dynamic content and real-time campaign management.
- [Mall Advertising](https://horizonooh.com/services/mall-advertising): Indoor advertising placements inside Egypt's top shopping malls.
- [Airport Advertising in Egypt](https://horizonooh.com/services/airport-advertising-in-egypt): High-visibility advertising at Cairo International Airport and other Egyptian airports.
- [Commercial Video Production](https://horizonooh.com/services/commercial-video-production): Full-service video production for OOH and broadcast advertising campaigns.
- [Outdoor Media Planning & Buying](https://horizonooh.com/services/outdoor-media-planning-buying): Strategic media planning, site selection, and media buying for OOH campaigns.
- [Full Campaign Execution](https://horizonooh.com/services/full-campaign-execution): End-to-end campaign management from creative to installation and reporting.
- [Event Management & Brand Activations](https://horizonooh.com/services/event-management-brand-activations): Live brand activation events and experiential marketing campaigns.
- [Ad Airing & Media Distribution](https://horizonooh.com/services/ad-airing-media-distribution): Media distribution and ad airing across OOH and broadcast networks.
- [Booth Activation & Production](https://horizonooh.com/services/booth-activation-production): Custom exhibition booth design, production, and activation.
- [In-Flight Advertising](https://horizonooh.com/services/in-flight-advertising): Advertising placements on Egyptian airline routes reaching high-value travelers.
- [PR & Communication Services](https://horizonooh.com/services/pr-communication-services): Public relations and integrated communication strategies for brand awareness.

- [Alexandria Billboards](https://horizonooh.com/locations/alexandria): Outdoor advertising locations in Alexandria, Egypt's second-largest city.

- [Beheira Billboards](https://horizonooh.com/locations/beheira): OOH advertising locations in Beheira Governorate.

- [Gharbia Billboards](https://horizonooh.com/locations/gharbia): Billboard locations in Gharbia Governorate.
